result.brief: 提出互补视觉传感器驱动的统一生成式重建框架，将多尺度时空特征注入视频扩散模型与VAE解码器，统一去模糊、插帧与HDR融合。
result.reason: Uses video diffusion prior with VAE-decoder feature injection for reconstruction; contributes to generative latent-space and video prior design, though task is sensor reconstruction rather than world modeling.
